Article 15 of the GDPR gives a data subject the right to obtain from the controller confirmation whether their personal data are being processed and, if so, access to those personal data plus related information (such as the purposes of processing, categories of data, recipients, retention period, and the existence of automated decision‑making). It also entitles the data subject to receive a copy of the personal data undergoing processing (the controller may charge a reasonable fee for further copies), and the right to obtain a copy must not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj?locale=EN&utm_source=openai))

Source: EUR-Lex — Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 15 (Right of access). https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj?locale=EN
